[[File:Small stellated truncated dodecahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a small stellated truncated dodecahedron]]
In [[three-dimensional]] [[geometry]], the '''small stellated truncated dodecahedron''' (or '''quasitruncated small stellated dodecahedron''' or '''small stellatruncated dodecahedron''') is a [[nonconvex uniform polyhedron]], indexed as U<sub>58</sub>. It has 24 faces (12 [[pentagon]]s and 12 [[Decagram (geometry)|decagrams]]), 90 edges, and 60 vertices.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathconsult.ch/static/unipoly/58.html|title=58: small stellated truncated dodecahedron|last=Maeder|first=Roman|date=|website=MathConsult|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> It is given a [[Schläfli symbol]] t&lbrace;{{Frac|5|3}},5}, and [[Coxeter diagram]] {{CDD|node_1|5-3|node_1|5|node}}.

== Related polyhedra ==

It shares its [[vertex arrangement]] with three other [[uniform polyhedron|uniform polyhedra]]: the convex [[rhombicosidodecahedron]], the [[small dodecicosidodecahedron]] and the [[small rhombidodecahedron]].

It also has the same vertex arrangement as the [[Uniform polyhedron compound|uniform compounds]] of [[compound of six pentagrammic prisms|6]] or [[compound of twelve pentagrammic prisms|12 pentagrammic prisms]].
